about.title: About me
about.text: I'm a final-year secondary school student. In my free time I run and race seriously. I can also eat a lot. Whenever I can, I hit the road: I love hitchhiking, spontaneous trips and discovering new cultures, and I'm a big supporter of really low-budget travel. I'm fascinated by how countries build their infrastructure, how transport networks work – and by maps.
about.work: I have helped organise school events and volunteered at sports events.

mmspace.ufo: Take me to your Nutella! || We come in peace. And hungry. || Your planet has 8 billion people and zero free parking. || Beep boop. Is this Budapest or Bucharest? || We've been watching. You should stretch more.
mmspace.jar: I'm not a planet. Yet. || Zero gravity, zero spoons. Tragic. || I orbit around bread. || Palm oil? Never heard of it. 👀 || Open me and the universe smells like hazelnut.
mmspace.cow: Moo. The grass is greener on Mars. || I jumped over the Moon. Now I can't get back. || Milky Way? That was me. || Zero-gravity milk comes out as little balls. || Please don't tell the farmer where I am.
mmspace.washer: Spin cycle: 40 degrees and weightlessness. || I've lost 4,000 socks. They're all up here somewhere. || Delicates: the whole Milky Way. || My door won't open until the universe stops spinning. || Beeeep. Your laundry is done. 3 light years ago.
mmspace.chile: I'm not a chilli pepper, I'm Chile! 4,300 km long, 177 km wide. || Desert at the top, glaciers at the bottom, avocados in the middle. || I have the driest desert on Earth. Bring water. || Hitchhiking me end to end? Doable. Ask around. || Earthquakes? We just call them Tuesdays.
mmspace.southam: I look like South America. Or an ice-cream cone. || Two scoops: Amazon and Andes. || Turn me upside down and I'm a tooth. || Patagonia is my melting tip. || Twelve countries, one very long mountain range.

story.running: Running is my main sport, and I swim too. My longest run so far was 30 km – but I think I could run a marathon (42 km) any time.
story.hitchhiking: I don't have much experience yet: my longest trip was to Lake Balaton, with two rides. I find it really exciting, and since I love low-budget travel, I want to do it a lot more.
story.maps: I love maps, and I want to work in geography. I like travelling any way: by plane, by train, hitchhiking, by bike or on foot.
story.budget: When I travel, why spend a lot if it can be done without? It's even more exciting that way – and it brings me closer to people. That's why I love hitchhiking.
story.languages: There's always a new language that fascinates me: first Spanish, then Georgian – and it doesn't stop there, right now I'm thinking about Portuguese. Probably because I love getting to know all kinds of countries, partly thanks to GeoGuessr.
story.eating: A whole jar of Nutella? Three plates of spaghetti bolognese? No problem. I love eating, especially sweets – but honestly anything, as long as there's a lot of it. (Lidl's discounted pastries – yum!)
story.lang.english: I've been learning it since I was 13, and at the Erasmus projects it stuck to me pretty fast. I use it well: I can express almost every thought in it.
story.lang.german: I've been learning it since I was 8, but sadly I don't pay much attention in class, because we always just do the basics. In German the gap between A2 and B2 is big: I can express myself at a basic level, but sometimes a word won't come to mind, and the complicated word orders are hard for me.
story.lang.spanish: I got into it because I fell in love with Chile and all of South America (GeoGuessr has a lot to do with it) – and loads of people speak it anyway. I can introduce myself at an intermediate level, but very fast speech is still hard to follow.
story.lang.georgian: At the Erasmus in Lithuania I met some Georgians who were really nice. They showed me their alphabet – I learned it and fell in love with the language. It's very hard, so for now I only know a few words and a few endings.
race.split.text: This is where I ran my 34:40 personal best – even with 100 m of climbing up and down in it. The atmosphere was amazing, and I finished 2nd overall!
race.skyrunning.text: I raced two distances: the Vertical and the Sky. I loved it! I finished mid-pack, but it was a huge experience – and on the way home we travelled through Bosnia.

plans.more.text: Have an idea, or want to come along? Write to me – maybe we'll plan the next one together!
plan1.story: I'd like to hitchhike around Chile for several weeks – or even months – and explore everything there is to see along the way.
plan1.facts: ["🗓 weeks or months", "👍 hitchhiking", "🧭 explore it all"]
plan2.story: I'm going this December! I find it a fascinating country, with an incredible variety of landscapes.
plan3.story: If you have ideas or want to join, write to me! You can also help me out with a place to stay – or with a jar of Nutella. 😄
plan3.facts: ["💡 ideas welcome", "🛏 a place to stay?", "🫙 Nutella accepted"]
plan4.story: Another fascinating region. Here the low-budget challenge is a bit bigger – but I love a challenge, it would be an amazing experience, and people there are really kind.
plan4.facts: ["💸 a bigger challenge", "🌬 wind and space", "🤝 kind people"]
plan5.story: I want to keep improving as a runner. Right now my 10k and 5k times are the most tangible goals – but who knows, maybe one day I'll run ultras too. On shorter distances (3 km) I'm not very fast yet, so I'd like to get better there – and in swimming as well.

mmspace.astronaut: Houston, I forgot my keys. || Up here a sunrise every 90 minutes. Very bad for sleep. || I can see your house from here. Tidy your room. || Space smells like burnt steak. Seriously. || I grew 5 cm up here. Gravity is a scam.
mmspace.rocket: 3… 2… 1… oops, forgot the snacks. || Next stop: the Moon. Then a coffee. || I run on fuel. You run on dumplings. Same thing. || Window seat, please! || Sorry for the noise – I'm a bit of an engine.
mmspace.satellite: Recalculating route… you went the wrong way again. || I see 200 traffic jams right now. You're in one. || Wi-Fi password? Ask the cow. || I take a photo of Earth every second. You never smile. || Signal lost… just kidding.
mmspace.sock: Yes, I'm the one missing from your drawer. || My partner is still in the washing machine. || I escaped and I regret nothing. || Single sock, ready to mingle. || I smell like 3 marathons. Sorry, Mars.
mmspace.pizza: Pineapple on me? Out of this world. Literally. || Delivered in 30 minutes or 30 light years. || I'm a triangle, so I point the way. || Cheese in zero gravity: impossible to control. || The last slice always ends up in space.
mmspace.duck: Quack. Debugging the universe. || I float in the bath, I float in space. Talent. || Tell me your problem. I won't judge. || One small quack for a duck… || There's no water up here and nobody warned me.
mmspace.toaster: Your toast is ready. It just flew to Jupiter. || Setting: golden brown, like a sunset on Venus. || Pop! Oops, there goes another one. || I'm the only toaster that has seen the Earth from above. || Bread in, stars out.
mmspace.shoe: I ran so fast I left the atmosphere. || Personal best: one lap around the Moon. || Where's my other half? Probably at the finish line. || Skyrunning, but higher. || My laces are untied. In space that's dangerous.
mmspace.thumb: Hitchhiking to Saturn. Anyone going that way? || First rule of the galaxy: always carry a towel. || A UFO stopped, but it was going the wrong way. || Waiting time so far: 3 hours, 2 comets. || Smile, make a sign, never give up.
mmspace.dumpling: Khinkali, pierogi, momo, gyoza – we're one big family. || Eat me from the top. Don't lose the soup! || I'm round, so technically I'm a planet. || Dumplings in space: the soup floats away first. || Twelve folds minimum, or I'm not getting dressed.
mmspace.backpack: Packed for a weekend. Been travelling for 3 years. || Inside: a sleeping bag, two maps and a lost banana. || My zip broke somewhere over Bolivia. || Low budget, high orbit. || I've slept in more places than most hotels.
mmspace.comet: Make a wish! Quick, I don't stop. || I come back every 76 years. Put the kettle on. || My tail is longer than your to-do list. || I'm basically a dirty snowball with confidence. || Next pass: right over your house. Look up!
